questions.q: Haldighati ka yudh kab hua tha?
questions.explain: 18 June 1576 — Maharana Pratap vs Mughal sena (Man Singh ke netritv me).

questions.q: Chittorgarh ka durg (maanyata ke anusaar) kisne banwaya tha?
questions.explain: Chitrangada Mori ke naam par hi Chittorgarh (Chitrakoot) naam pada.

questions.q: Jaisalmer ka durg kisne banwaya tha?
questions.explain: 1155 AD me Bhati vanshiya Rawal Jaisal ne — isi liye sheher ka naam Jaisalmer pada.

questions.q: Kumbhalgarh ka durg kisne banwaya?
questions.explain: Rana Kumbha ne 15vi sadi me banwaya — Aravali ki pahadiyon me sthit.

questions.q: Kavigyi Meera Bai ki shaadi kiske saath hui thi?
questions.explain: Meera Bai ki shaadi Mewar ke Rana Sanga ke putra Bhojraj ke saath hui thi.

questions.q: Rajasthan Diwas kab manaya jata hai?
questions.explain: 30 March 1949 ko 'Greater Rajasthan' ka nirman hua tha.

questions.q: 'Prithviraj Raso' granth kisne likha?
questions.explain: Chand Bardai Prithviraj Chauhan ke darbari kavi the.

questions.q: Amer ke durg ka nirman kisne karaya?
questions.explain: Raja Man Singh I ne 16vi sadi me Amer durg ka nirman karaya.

questions.q: 'Rajasthan ka Gandhi' kis shaksiyat ko kaha jata hai?
questions.explain: Sirohi se sanbandhit Gokulbhai Bhatt — swatantrata sangram senani aur 'Rajasthan ka Gandhi'.

questions.q: Kshetrafal ke drishti se Bharat ka sabse bada rajya kaun sa hai?
questions.explain: Rajasthan (~3.42 lakh sq km) — Bharat ke kul kshetrafal ka lagbhag 10.4%.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka sabse uncha sthan kaun sa hai?
questions.explain: Guru Shikhar, Mount Abu — lagbhag 1722 meter, Aravali shreni me.

questions.q: Rajasthan ki sabse lambi nadi kaun si hai?
questions.explain: Chambal — Yamuna ki sahayak nadi, Rajasthan me sabse lamba biodha.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka kshetrafal me sabse bada jila kaun sa hai?
questions.explain: Jaisalmer — lagbhag 38,000 sq km ke saath sabse bada jila.

questions.q: Sambhar jheel kis prakar ki jheel hai?
options: Mitha pani ki sabse badi jheel
questions.explain: Sambhar — Bharat ki sabse badi andlandi namkeen pani ki jheel; namak utpadan bhi hota hai.

questions.q: Luni nadi ka jal kahan jake milta hai?
questions.explain: Luni — Ajmer ke Naga pahad se nikal kar Rann of Kachchh me samapt.

questions.q: 'Rajasthan ka Cherrapunji' kis jile ko kaha jata hai?
questions.explain: Jhalawar — Rajasthan me sabse zyada varsha wala kshetra.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka Thar marusthal dusre naam se kya kaha jata hai?
questions.explain: Thar ko 'Marusthali' bhi kaha jata hai.

questions.q: Jaisamand jheel kis nadi par bani hai?
questions.explain: Udaipur ke paas Gomti nadi par — Bharat ki sabse badi artificial freshwater jheelon me se ek.

questions.q: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha me kul kitne vidhayak (sadasye) hote hain?
questions.explain: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha ki kul shaktiyan 200 vidhayak hain.

questions.q: Rajasthan High Court kahan sthit hai?
questions.explain: Mukhya High Court Jodhpur me — Jaipur me iski bench hai.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka pehla mukhyamantri kaun tha?
questions.explain: Heera Lal Shastri — Greater Rajasthan ke pehle mukhyamantri (1949).

questions.q: Bharat me Panchayati Raj ki shuruaat kis rajya se hui?
questions.explain: 2 October 1959 — Rajasthan ke Nagaur jile me, Pt. Nehru ke haathon se.

questions.q: Rajya Sabha me Rajasthan ke kitne sadasye hain?
questions.explain: Rajya Sabha me Rajasthan ki 10 seats hain.

questions.q: Lok Sabha me Rajasthan se kitne seats hain?
questions.explain: Rajasthan se Lok Sabha me 25 seats hain.

questions.q: Matsya Sangh me kaun se jile shaamil the?
questions.explain: 18 March 1948 ko bana Matsya Sangh — Alwar, Bharatpur, Dholpur aur Karauli.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka ekmatra pramukh pahadi sthaan (hill station) kaun sa hai?
questions.explain: Mount Abu — Sirohi jile me, Aravali ki ghati me sthit.

questions.q: Hawa Mahal (Jaipur) kisne banwaya?
questions.explain: 1799 me Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh ne banwaya — 956 jharokhe.

questions.q: Kalbelia nritya ko UNESCO ki intangible heritage list me kab shaamil kiya gaya?
questions.explain: 2010 me — Rajasthan ka Kalbelia nritya UNESCO list me shaamil hua.

questions.q: Puskar ka prasidh mela kis purnima par lagta hai?
questions.explain: Kartik Purnima par — Puskar mela duniya ka prasidh oont mela bhi hai.

questions.q: Karni Mata ka mandir (jahan chuhe pooje jate hain) kahan sthit hai?
questions.explain: Deshnok (Bikaner) — Karni Mata ka prasidh mandir.

questions.q: Chittorgarh ka Vijay Stambh kisne banwaya?
questions.explain: Rana Kumbha ne Mahmud Khilji par vijay ke smaran me banwaya.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka rajya pakshi kaun sa hai?
questions.explain: Godavan (Great Indian Bustard) — Jaisalmer ke Drone Sanctuary me milta hai.

questions.q: Rajasthan ka rajya vriksh kaun sa hai?
questions.explain: Khejri ( Prosopis cineraria ) — marusthal ka kalpavriksha kaha jata hai.

questions.q: 'Phad' chitrakala kis jile se judi hai?
questions.explain: Phad painting — Shahpura (Bhilwara) ki prasidh lok chitrakala.

questions.q: 'Surya Nagri' kis shahar ko kaha jata hai?
questions.explain: Jodhpur — Surya Nagri; Jaipur Gulabi Shahar, Jaisalmer Sunahri Shahar, Udaipur Jheelon ka Shahar.
